verdict.rationale: Bolna is a voice-agent platform whose agents call tools, so connecting external MCP servers as a tool source is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only the opposite role: an official Bolna MCP server that external MCP clients like Claude and Cursor connect to. Built-in tools and provider integrations are adjacent features, and nothing shows Bolna agents consuming external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
